title: AI smart glasses brand breaks Japan crowdfunding record, adds Gemini Flash 3.5 and enters Australia
content: China-based AI smart eyewear brand Rokid has accelerated its global expansion and technological roadmap, supported by a wave of momentum across its hardware and open AI ecosystem. From major software upgrades to record-breaking market demand and new regional territory launches, the company is solidifying its position at the forefront of spatial computing.

title: Phison shifts to system AI solutions with 2027 memory crunch looming
content: Phison Electronics CEO K.S. Pua said the company is moving beyond its roots as an IC component supplier and repositioning itself as a system solutions provider, warning that AI-driven memory shortages could become more severe in 2027 than in the second half of 2026.

title: AI demand squeezes mainstream DRAM supply as DDR5, DDR4 prices rise
content: DRAM prices are climbing as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron Technology prioritize high-bandwidth memory, or HBM, for AI applications, tightening supply of mainstream DDR5 and DDR4 products used in PCs, servers, and other electronics, according to Nikkei.

title: Jensen Huang shouts 'Everyone loves HBM' at Seoul barbecue as Nvidia announces Korea R&D center and previews four new products
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dined with the heads of South Korea's largest technology conglomerates in Hongdae on June 5, turning a barbecue dinner into one of the most theatrical corporate appearances of his Korea trip.

title: From Taiwan's supply chain to South Korea's Faker: how Jensen Huang reads different markets
content: Jensen Huang wrapped up his Taiwan run at GTC Taipei and Computex 2026 and flew to South Korea on June 5. His first stop was not Samsung or SK Hynix. It was Hongdae, where he met T1 star Faker — Lee Sang-hyeok — co-signed an RTX 5090 graphics card, and immediately set the internet on fire.
